coverage_assessment: Open-web discovery covered all four January weeks; national and regional reporting; labor, education, service delivery, housing, student, transport, COVID-policy, political and migration leads; and Afrikaans, isiZulu and isiXhosa queries. Direct source access and date filters were uneven, local-language verification was limited, and several leads remain blocked, search-only or unresolved. This is not an exhaustive absence claim or a substitute for systematic archives.
